title: Web Scraping & Crawling Tools
summary: This module provides a comprehensive collection of tools for web scraping and crawling, integrating with various third-party services and direct methods. It enables agents to extract content from websites, perform searches, and manage web data programmatically for diverse applications.

nodes.label: Load Webpage (Browserbase)
nodes.title: BrowserbaseLoadTool
nodes.description: Utilizes Browserbase to load web pages in a headless browser, extracting their content. Supports options for text content, session management, and proxy usage to bypass common scraping obstacles.

nodes.label: Crawl Website (Firecrawl)
nodes.title: FirecrawlCrawlWebsiteTool
nodes.description: Enables comprehensive website crawling through the Firecrawl v2 API. Configurable with parameters like discovery depth, sitemap ignoring, page limits, and external link handling to gather extensive web data.

nodes.label: Scrape Webpage (Firecrawl)
nodes.title: FirecrawlScrapeWebsiteTool
nodes.description: Scrapes specific web pages using the Firecrawl v2 API, extracting content in various formats. Offers detailed configuration for content filtering, tag inclusion/exclusion, caching, and browser emulation for precise data retrieval.

nodes.label: Search Web (Firecrawl)
nodes.title: FirecrawlSearchTool
nodes.description: Performs web searches via the Firecrawl v2 API, returning structured results. Allows customization of search limits, time-based filters, location, and scraping options for the search results themselves.

nodes.label: Load Web Content (Hyperbrowser)
nodes.title: HyperbrowserLoadTool
nodes.description: Provides advanced web scraping and crawling capabilities using the Hyperbrowser API. It can extract content in markdown or HTML, with options for session management and detailed scrape configurations.

nodes.label: Scrape Webpage (Jina.ai)
nodes.title: JinaScrapeWebsiteTool
nodes.description: Leverages Jina.ai's reader service to convert website content into markdown format, simplifying processing for LLMs. Supports custom headers for authentication and request customization.

nodes.label: Scrape Webpage (Scrapfly)
nodes.title: ScrapflyScrapeWebsiteTool
nodes.description: Utilizes the Scrapfly API to scrape web pages, returning content as markdown or plain text. Provides robust scraping capabilities with configurable options and error handling for reliable data extraction.

nodes.label: Scrape Webpage (Selenium)
nodes.title: SeleniumScrapingTool
nodes.description: Automates web browser interactions using Selenium to scrape website content. Supports headless browsing, cookie management, and extraction of specific CSS elements or the entire page HTML/text.

nodes.label: Scrape Specific Element
nodes.title: ScrapeElementFromWebsiteTool
nodes.description: Extracts specific HTML elements from a given website URL using CSS selectors. It makes direct HTTP requests and parses the response with BeautifulSoup, supporting custom headers and cookies.

nodes.label: Scrape Entire Webpage
nodes.title: ScrapeWebsiteTool
nodes.description: Fetches and parses the entire content of a website, converting it into a clean, LLM-ready text format. Uses direct HTTP requests and BeautifulSoup for parsing, with support for custom headers and cookies.

nodes.label: Intelligent Scrape (Scrapegraph)
nodes.title: ScrapegraphScrapeTool
nodes.description: Intelligently scrapes website content using the Scrapegraph AI API, designed to extract main content based on a user prompt. Handles URL validation, API responses, and rate limiting for robust operation.

nodes.label: Convert Webpage to Markdown (Serply)
nodes.title: SerplyWebpageToMarkdownTool
nodes.description: Converts web pages into a clean markdown format using the Serply API, optimizing content for LLM consumption. Supports proxy location settings and custom headers for flexible requests.

nodes.label: Scrape/Crawl (Spider.cloud)
nodes.title: SpiderTool
nodes.description: Offers comprehensive web scraping and crawling functionalities through the Spider.cloud API. It can extract content from single pages or crawl multiple pages, returning LLM-ready output with configurable parameters.

nodes.label: Browserbase Service
nodes.title: Browserbase
nodes.description: An external service providing headless browser capabilities for web automation and data extraction.

nodes.label: Firecrawl API
nodes.title: Firecrawl
nodes.description: An external API offering advanced web scraping, crawling, and search functionalities with structured output.

nodes.label: Hyperbrowser API
nodes.title: Hyperbrowser
nodes.description: An external service for scraping and crawling web pages, providing content in various formats like markdown or HTML.

nodes.label: Jina.ai Reader API
nodes.title: Jina.ai Reader
nodes.description: An external API that processes web page content and converts it into a clean, readable markdown format.

nodes.label: Scrapfly API
nodes.title: Scrapfly
nodes.description: A web scraping API that provides tools for extracting data from websites, handling proxies, and rendering JavaScript.

nodes.label: Web Browser (Selenium)
nodes.title: Selenium
nodes.description: A browser automation framework used for controlling web browsers programmatically, enabling dynamic content scraping.

nodes.label: Website (HTTP Request)
nodes.title: Direct HTTP Access
nodes.description: Represents direct HTTP/HTTPS requests made to websites to fetch raw HTML content for parsing.

nodes.label: Scrapegraph AI API
nodes.title: Scrapegraph AI
nodes.description: An AI-powered web scraping service that intelligently extracts relevant content from web pages based on user prompts.

nodes.label: Serply API
nodes.title: Serply
nodes.description: An API service that converts web pages into markdown format, simplifying content for LLM processing and analysis.

nodes.label: Spider.cloud API
nodes.title: Spider.cloud
nodes.description: A web scraping and crawling API that provides structured data extraction from websites, supporting both single-page scrapes and multi-page crawls.

groups.label: API-Driven Scraping Services
groups.title: API-Driven Scraping Services
groups.description: This group includes tools that leverage external APIs for web scraping and crawling, offering robust and scalable solutions for data extraction.

groups.label: Direct Web Content Extraction
groups.title: Direct Web Content Extraction
groups.description: This group encompasses tools that perform web scraping using local libraries or direct browser automation, providing fine-grained control over the extraction process.
